title: Good Burger
about: A slacker owing money for a car crash takes a job at Good Burger, where cashier Ed's secret sauce takes on the giant Mondo Burger across the street.
cue: Serve the burgers when Dexter finds the sauce Ed made for his lunch.
faces: "Welcome to Good Burger, home of the Good Burger. Can I take your order?"

    SnacksOtis's fries with Ed's sauceEd's sauce makes Otis glad he's not dead. Crisp fries, a tangy secret sauce.How to make it1kg frozen thick-cut chips1 lemon4 tbsp tomato sauce125g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet pickle relish1 tsp yellow mustard1 tsp smoked paprika1/2 tsp garlic powderBake the chips on two trays at 220°C, turning once, until deep gold and crisp.Start the sauce with a squeeze of lemon juice and the tomato sauce, then whisk in the mayo, relish, mustard, paprika and garlic powder.Salt the hot fries and serve with a big bowl of sauce.Extra Ed's sauce on the sideIt starts with a little lemon juice. That's all we're saying.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Something-on-it cheeseburger slidersA meat patty is something, says Ed. Mini beef patties, cheese, pickles.How to make it500g beef mince8 slider buns8 slices of American cheese16 dill pickle slices1/2 white onion, finely diced3 tbsp tomato sauce2 tbsp yellow mustardRoll the mince into 8 balls and season well.Smash each ball flat on a very hot griddle and cook 2 minutes until crusty, then flip and top with cheese.Toast the buns on the griddle.Build with sauce, mustard, onion, pickles and the patties and serve hot.Hot FoodThe Good Burger with Ed's sauceEd's secret sauce saves Good Burger. Double beef, cheese, Ed's sauce.How to make it700g beef mince, 20 per cent fat4 sesame burger buns8 slices of cheddar4 iceberg lettuce leaves2 tomatoes, sliced1 red onion, thinly sliced1 lemon3 tbsp tomato sauce100g whole-egg mayonnaise2 tbsp sweet pickle relishMix a squeeze of lemon with the tomato sauce, mayo and relish to make the sauce.Shape the mince into 8 thin patties and season well.Cook on a very hot griddle 2 minutes a side, laying cheese on each after the flip.Toast the buns cut side down.Stack two patties per bun with lettuce, tomato, onion and lots of sauce.Kurt's Mondo grinderMess with Kurt, into the grinder. Meatball sub, red sauce, provolone.How to make it500g pork and veal mince50g dried breadcrumbs1 egg40g parmesan, grated2 garlic cloves, crushed700ml jar tomato passata1 tsp dried oregano4 long sub rolls8 slices of provolone1/2 cup basil leavesMix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt and roll into 16 balls.Brown the meatballs in a hot oiled pan, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic and simmer.Split the rolls, fill with meatballs and sauce and lay the provolone on top.Grill until the cheese melts and bubbles, then finish with basil.Ices and SweetsIce cream truck getaway choc topsEd pelts a truck with ice cream. Choc-dipped vanilla cones.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream8 waffle cones200g dark chocolate, chopped60ml coconut oil2 tbsp rainbow sprinklesMelt the chocolate with the coconut oil gently and cool to room temperature.Scoop the ice cream firmly into the cones, pressing a ball on top, and freeze for 10 minutes.Dip each top in the chocolate, scatter with sprinkles and stand upright in a glass until set.Cold DrinksGrape Nose Boy grape soda spiderEd turns into Grape Nose Boy at lunch. Grape soda over vanilla ice cream, bloobity.How to make it1.3 L grape soda8 scoops of vanilla ice cream1 cup red grapes, halvedDrop two scoops of ice cream into each of 4 tall chilled glasses.Pour the soda slowly down the side so it foams up.Top with a few grape halves and serve with a long spoon and straw.Bottomless fountain sodaCustomers aren't allowed in the back.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
